min_standing_note.notes: Open to UG, PG, PhD nominated under active partner agreements (PDF p.5); no fixed semester-count prerequisite published in Fact Sheet.

excluded_majors.notes: No excluded major list published in 2024/25 Fact Sheet.

min_gpa_host.notes: Undergraduate CGPA minimum 2.20/4.00; Graduate CGPA minimum 2.50/4.00 per OIP incoming exchange rules.

instruction_languages.notes: Medium of instruction at Koç University is English in all cycles and programs.

english_course_availability.notes: Instruction is in English across all cycles and programs.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: CEFR B2 English proficiency required: TOEFL iBT >=80, equivalent accepted test, OR an official letter from the home institution's English Department / Exchange Office confirming adequate English proficiency.

host_language_requirement.value: None required for coursework; optional Turkish Practice Hour and online Turkish course offered (p.4).

fall_term_dates.value: Published on Koç Registrar Academic Calendar (https://registrar.ku.edu.tr/en/academic-calendar/); exact 2026-27 Fall day-by-day dates not retrieved verbatim.

spring_term_dates.value: Published on Koç Registrar Academic Calendar (https://registrar.ku.edu.tr/en/academic-calendar/); exact 2026-27 Spring day-by-day dates not retrieved verbatim.

tuition_model.notes: Partner-nominated exchange students receive a full tuition waiver at Koç University.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: OIP notes students fund their own living expenses; no official numeric monthly TRY/EUR living budget verified directly from ku.edu.tr.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: No official numeric monthly budget verified from ku.edu.tr.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Active health insurance covering stay in Türkiye required for mandatory Student Residence Permit.

housing_availability.notes: On-campus dormitories available to exchange students subject to application and space availability (off-campus support also provided).

housing_notes.value: On-campus dormitory application handled via exchange portal; off-campus housing guidance also coordinated via OIP/ICO.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: No Koç incoming bilateral exchange stipend verified.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Entry visa/e-Visa requirements depend on nationality (check prior to travel); stays >90 days require a Turkish Student Residence Permit coordinated collectively on campus by Koç International Community Services Office (ICO).

english_course_list_url.notes: English is the medium of instruction across all cycles; course list linked directly from Fact Sheet p.5.

credit_system_and_load.notes: Credit limits/ECTS conversion not explicitly printed in the 2024/25 Fact Sheet or verified ku.edu.tr excerpts.

course_restrictions_note.notes: No course-restriction table verified in Fact Sheet or ku.edu.tr excerpts.

value: English B2 proficiency proof (TOEFL iBT >=80 or home institution letter)

academic_style.notes: Not explicitly described in Fact Sheet or verified ku.edu.tr snippets.
